items.exampleEn: Music always puts me in a better mood.
items.exampleZh: 音樂總能讓我心情變好。

items.exampleEn: I always feel nervous before a test.
Can you do me a favor?
My mom was mad at me for coming home late.
items.exampleZh: 我太晚回家，我媽很生我的氣。

items.exampleEn: He made a fortune selling cars.
The ending of the movie was surprising.
items.exampleZh: 這部電影的結局出人意料。

items.exampleEn: She looked at her son with pride.
This city is attractive to young people.
items.exampleZh: 這座城市對年輕人很有吸引力。

items.sentenceEn: I'm in a bad mood today.

items.audioEn: He was so nervous that he forgot his phone number.
items.audioZh: 他緊張到忘了自己的電話號碼。
items.questionZh: 他為什麼忘了自己的電話號碼？

items.sentenceEn: Thank you for doing me a favor.
It's surprising how fast children grow.
items.sentenceZh: 孩子長大的速度快得令人驚訝。

items.stemEn: Don't be ____. It was not my idea.
items.stemZh: 別生氣，那不是我的主意。

items.stemEn: She felt great ____ when her son finished school.
items.stemZh: 兒子完成學業時，她感到非常驕傲。

items.passageEn: Last week, my brother had a job interview at a big company. He was very nervous and in a bad mood all morning, so I did him a favor and drove him there. The result was surprising: they offered him the job right away! The pay is attractive, and my parents are full of pride. "It's not a fortune," he said, "but it's a good start."
items.passageZh: 上週，我哥哥去一家大公司面試。他整個早上都很緊張、心情也不好，所以我幫了他一個忙，開車載他過去。結果出人意料：他們當場就錄取了他！薪水很吸引人，我爸媽也非常以他為傲。他說：「這不算什麼大錢，但是個好的開始。」

questions.questionZh: 面試那天早上，哥哥怎麼了？
options: 一直在房間裡練習講話
公司要他下週再來一次

referenceEn: I'm in a good mood today.
I am in a very good mood today.
rubricZh: 「心情很好」可寫例如 in a good mood（I'm in a good mood）
be 動詞配合主詞（例如 I am、I'm）

items.promptZh: 她去年第一次上台唱歌時很緊張。
referenceEn: She was nervous when she first sang on stage last year.
Last year, she felt nervous the first time she sang on stage.
rubricZh: 用 nervous 表示「緊張的」（例如 was nervous、felt nervous 等）
去年的事用過去式（例如 was、sang 等）
「第一次」可寫，例如 first sang、the first time、for the first time 等
